title: SAP reportedly weighs at least 10,000 job cuts as it reorganizes around AI; SAP says no decisions have been made
summary: Bloomberg reported on November 26, 2026 that SAP is preparing to cut at least 10,000 positions as it reorganizes its software business for AI, with product, engineering and sales under particular review. In a statement to CNBC, SAP said AI is changing its business quickly and that no decisions on further measures have been made. SAP employs more than 110,000 people. CNBC notes that other software companies, including Atlassian and Cloudflare, tied job cuts to AI this year, and that Challenger, Gray & Christmas counted 121,401 announced U.S. job cuts citing AI through October 2026, about 20 percent of the total.
why: Big software vendors are reorganizing around AI, which can change the products, support and account teams that smaller businesses depend on.
